completion_receipt_acyclicity.SUPERVISOR_CLOSED_payload: binds prepared_body_sha256, terminal seal, notification outcome, release outcome and effects
completion_receipt_acyclicity.final_receipt: adds closeout_head reference and may include content hash in an external manifest only; no event points to final self-dependent hash
completion_receipt_acyclicity.prepared_body: all receipt fields except closeout_head and final receipt self-hash

failure_branches.rule: commit bounded failed/unknown outcome and continue closeout; semantic_result unchanged
record attempt/outcome; a witness integrity mismatch blocks trustworthy clean closeout without replacing semantic decision
retain transaction lock, enter lease-release HOLD/recovery, prohibit protected actions because release intent already fenced them, and do not commit clean SUPERVISOR_CLOSED
recover by deterministic rematerialization; append no event

ordered_transitions.gate: all owned children reconciled; unowned processes not killed
semantic_input_closed=true; exact reducer and post-freeze allowlist bound
same prefix, contract and reducer identity

ordered_transitions.event_or_action: MANIFEST_CREATED then TERMINAL_SEAL_CREATED then RUN_SEALED committed
ordered_transitions.gate: manifest and seal bind terminal_decision_head; immutable create-once publication

ordered_transitions.event_or_action: bounded notification request/submission and one terminal notification outcome
ordered_transitions.gate: DELIVERED_CONFIRMED or DELIVERY_FAILED or DELIVERY_UNKNOWN committed by deadline
witness outcome recorded without semantic rewrite
no protected action legal after acknowledged intent

ordered_transitions.event_or_action: AuthorityDB transition to RELEASE_PENDING then RELEASED with durable readback
ordered_transitions.gate: exact transaction, epoch, fencing token, scope and journal release-intent binding

ordered_transitions.event_or_action: prepare canonical completion-receipt body excluding not-yet-known closeout_head
ordered_transitions.gate: template digest binds seal, notification, release and effects without self-hash cycle
event is closeout_head and final canonical event; clean close requires release proof

ordered_transitions.event_or_action: materialize COMPLETION-RECEIPT.json, fsync, parent fsync and readback
ordered_transitions.gate: receipt binds closeout_head and prepared body
receipt verified; no journal append permitted
